text: Henrik - made redundant Thurs. v flat about it, 2 kids + mortgage. ring him Sat morning

Laura's dad passed Sunday night - heart attack, totally out of nowhere. she's at her mum's, in bits. funeral 3rd of Nov @ 11am, St Mary's then back to the house. her brother Joe flying back from Dubai Sat. send card + flowers to her mum's, and cover her Tues/Weds shifts - told Barbara I would
Nikhil @ standup - presenting to the Haddad client Weds at 2. nervous, keeps redoing slides. text him good luck tues eve
gig Fri 14/11 - Gemma's band @ the Fleece, doors 8pm. I'm driving her + Rin
Mustafa & his wife split up. moved into his brother Abdi's spare room for now

Sean - half marathon Sun 9th, start 9am, aiming sub 2hrs. first one since his knee op last yr. been doing physio twice a wk but knee playing up again since Thurs. his wife Ilse thinks he should pull out, he won't hear of it. stubborn as ever lol
remind me to ask Matteo how the recital went - his daughter's grade 5 piano, was last night
Jin's new manager = nightmare apparently. micromanages everything, cc's her boss on all emails
dentist moved to 12/11 @ half 9. bins out tues
Nikolai Petrov (Kolya) - leaving drinks Fri 21st from 5.30 @ the Crown. collection going round, chip in £10
Noah - gutted, got dumped by text. weekend in pieces. check in tmrw lunchtime
Imani's play opens 28 Nov - Lady Macbeth!! am dying to see it. book tix for the Sat matinee
Barbara (Mrs Thomas next door) - husband Noah in hospice. daughter flying in from Perth on 2nd Dec
Ilse - interview @ the council 4 Dec, 10am. 2nd stage. she's convinced she'll mess it up
Uma + Theo got engaged on hols in Lisbon!! party 17th Jan, venue tbc
Yara - fav band = Wet Leg. vinyl collector. vegan
Anjali's dog Biscuit - op on Mon morning, lump removed. she's beside herself
Dafydd - Wales v NZ @ the Principality 15 Nov, he's got a spare ticket. said yes
Oisín's gran died last wk. funeral in Galway Thurs, he's flying out Weds pm. ask him if he needs lift to airport
Lola - quiz night called off (landlord sold the pub). doing mine instead next month?
Abdi got promoted to team lead!! starts new role after Xmas. drinks?

Seo-yeon - piano competition in Leeds 7th Dec, final round 3pm. practising 6hrs/day, not sleeping, barely eating. her mum v worried, rang me about it. teacher says she's the best prepared she's been. playing the Rachmaninov she's been working on since summer. msg her the night before, nothing heavy
Lucy back from mat leave 1st Dec. baby Ava now 9 months. she's anxious re: returning, new team structure etc

Caitlin re Q3 review - boss (Mr Le) gave her 'needs improvement'. no warning, all her 1:1s were fine. thinks she's being pushed out bc she raised the overtime thing w/ HR in Aug. she's got the HR mtg Fri at 4 + union rep coming. need to call her after, and dig out that email chain she sent me
Joe - 5 a side final Tues 8pm. if they win it's the league. lads v hyped
Ming's sister Lola had baby boy 18/10! 7lb 2. Ming = auntie now, over the moon
Emre - whole dept made redundant, 30 days notice. last day 14 Nov. looking at contracting. send him the recruiter's details
Giulia's opera thing (La Bohème, chorus) - 22 + 23 Nov, 7.30. Louis going 22nd, maybe we go 23rd
Louis - quiet since breakup w/ Yara. didn't come to pub. don't forget to text him this wk
call re boiler service tmrw morning. also renew car insurance before 30/10
Henrik follow up - he's got 2 interviews lined up!! one Mon 10am, one Thurs. sounds better
Laura back @ work Mon. go easy. she said funeral was lovely, loads came
client mtg Haddad & co moved to Thurs 6 Nov 9am. Nikhil to lead, me on notes
Gemma - turning 30 on 3rd of Jan. wants a film camera, keeps sending me Olympus links. pass to Rin
Rin & partner Theo Suzuki - doing the Great North Run next Sept. training already
Mustafa - kids staying w/ ex weekdays, him weekends. hard on him. invite him for dinner Sun evening
Sean's mum - hip op 25 Nov. he's taking a wk off to look after her

Matteo - wedding's off. Giulia + him called it after 6 yrs, was meant to be 14 June. venue lost deposit. he's ok-ish, more relieved than anything. moving back to his parents' in Bristol for a bit. his mum's taking it worse than him. Barbara asked me if she should still keep the date free lol
Jin - thinking of quitting, has offer from Tanaka's firm. deciding by end of month. ask her Mon what she picked
Nikolai - big Arsenal fan, season ticket. hates mornings. coffee black
gym - fees going up Jan. cancel? check contract
Noah follow up - went on 1st date since breakup Sat. seemed happier. didn't ask more
Imani - opening night smashed it. review in local paper! she wants feedback, send her my notes

Barbara - Noah passed Tues early hrs, peacefully, daughter got there in time. funeral prob 10th or 11th Dec, she'll confirm. wants it small, no black. ask if she wants help w/ food after, and maybe sort her bins/shopping this wk
Ilse - got it!!! starts 6 Jan. senior planner. take her out to celebrate
Uma - wedding planning stress already. her mum wants church, Theo's parents want registry office. lol
Anjali - Biscuit op went fine, home Tues. stitches out in 10 days. she's knackered
Dafydd + his wife Anjali - anniversary 20 Nov, 10 yrs. he's planning surprise trip to Paris, don't say anything
Oisín - back from Galway. said was hard but good to see family. grandad on his own now
Lola - band practice moved Weds 7pm. gig Sat 29th @ Bodega cancelled - drummer's off sick
Abdi - his manager leaving too. restructure. he might take on her team
Seo-yeon - came 2nd!! £500 prize. mum cried. send congrats

Lucy's husband Nikhil made redundant same wk she goes back. typical. 15 yrs at that place. she's putting brave face on, says he'll do the nursery runs for now. their eldest starting reception Sept so money tight. don't mention it to Gemma, she's in his team
Caitlin - HR thing went ok, PIP not dismissal. 6 wks. she's job hunting anyway. I should send her the Williams & Le role
school run swap w/ Joe's wife Tues + Thurs next 2 wks. Joe away w/ work
Ming - running the Manchester 10k 18 May, for her dad's charity (Parkinson's). sponsor her
Emre's partner Yara - pregnant, due April. Emre stressing re money with redundancy
Giulia - Bohème was gorgeous. she mentioned wants to try for the main company next year, audition in Feb
tickets Ticketmaster for Fontaines DC 14/03 go on sale Fri at 9am. set alarm
Louis - saw him Sat. better. new flat in Peckham from 1st Dec, ex kept the cat (Mochi). he wants to get a dog eventually
